reviews.x: I had to come to the defense of this Lume product. I have spent literally hundreds of dollars in my lifetime to find a products that works for me. Even gone as far as getting RX deodorant from doctor which tore up my underarms and did not work. I am not exaggerating when I tell you NOTHING has worked for me until this. I have never had anything work like this product has. I did read some reviews about rash. I have used this products for over 2 months. I develop a rash under my arms using product

reviews.t: Works better than their other sticks
reviews.x: I tried the Lume cream stick and really wanted to like it. The consistency never felt like it dried, left me feeling like I was sweating and stinking even more, and would leave residue everywhere! I hadn't bought Lume in almost a year and even tried children's deodorant thinking it would help since puberty hits super hard so kids' stuff has to work right? NOT.  The Lume solid stick is a lifesaver. It goes on super smooth, doesn't have a dry time, smells nice and strong, and best of all, no smell

I’m the person that sweats even when they’re freezing, and thats the kind that usually stinks. NOT WITH THIS DEODORANT!!!!! I wore it all week to work and it was fine but the real tester was in all the layers of gear. Usually with all this gear on, I need to shower right away. With Lume, i didn’t smell at all. I swear by this stuff 🙌🏻 The cucumber melon smells REALLY good. Smells like the dove cucumber deodorant 👏🏻

I have used lume before… I thought it was effective, but I wasn’t a fan of the cream since it made my pits feel wet and it got all over the applicator and I couldn’t find a scent I really LOVED. But the solid sticks are AMAZING! Unlike other natural deodorants, it doesn’t have to sit under my arm to warm up enough to apply… just smooth application from the first swipe. Also… it WORKS. I am embarrassed to say, but I have searched high and low for a deodorant that helps with the smell. And I’m not

reviews.t: Very disappointed in this product It made me feel gross and dirt

reviews.x: I switched to a different "natural" deodorant a few months ago, and man I have hated the way I smell since. I heard you have to give it some time for your arm pits to "detox" all the bad chemicals out from the harsh regular (aluminum) deodorants. Well, after smelling for 2 months, I did some research and decided on Lume. It works great! FINALLY, a natural (aluminum free) deodorant that actually keeps you from smelling. I got the cucumber melon scent and it smells so good! Def worth the price!

reviews.t: I would be buying again! It’s my favorite purchase of the year
reviews.x: Ok, I must say I am not a review person, I saw this product in an instagram ad, I am a microbiologist so I love that the ad had some scientific back up for its claims, this is why I decided to give it a chance. The price it’s twice of what my to go deodorant usually is, however I have been looking for a more effective deodorant, I workout everyday and I am extremely conscious  of the my smell, I do not have a strong humor so I tend to forget to apply deodorant after I shower and it is usually un

I liked that it said 72 hour odor control with no aluminum and touted effectiveness. The price was ridiculously high but I thought if it was as good as it said that would be OK. The reality is this stuff is terrible! I didn’t want deodorant for any other part of my body except my underarms and it could not even control the odor there.  Unfortunately it took me a while after purchasing to try this because I had other deodorant that I was going to use up first so by the time I realized how awful a

reviews.t: This didn’t work for me at all
reviews.x: This didn’t work at all. I’ve tried the Lume cream deodorant, and while that worked to stop sweaty smell, I hated the way it smelled when I initially put it on. This solid stick doesn’t have that weird sour smell the original does, but it did absolutely nothing for sweat odor. It somehow made my sweat smell even worse than if I wore nothing. The cucumber melon scent was also a little odd, but I could have gotten past that if the product worked the way it claimed.

This has definitely blown all other deodorant brands out of the water that I've tried by far. I started using it for a couple of weeks. Pros- It works all day. I dont have to re-apply. I have noticed that even the next day, it is still working strong. Cons- This is my first time using this brand so I don't know what the other scents are like. Although this brand is working for me, like most reviews on here, the scent is not as great as you would think. So I will be using a different scent next t

I had previously tried the Jasmine rose cream deodorant and while it worked the initial scent was rather off putting. (honestly, it's nasty) The solid cucumber melon variety is SO much better scent-wise, and since it is a solid it goes on much more easily. The only thing I'm not crazy about is the price, but the product itself is fantastic.

I was really excited to use lume since I've seen it everywhere and it has such great reviews. I got the cucumber stick deodorant and it does not last. I seen someone said to stand in front of a fan to let it dry and I tried that but it still didn't last long. Maybe if I try the other one and not the stick it might work but I'm hesitant now.

I bought the cucumber melon solid stick and it had a really bad smell. It was like when you leave wet clothes in the washer for a day. I love the original Lume cream deodorant. I don’t know if it was the scent I picked or the solid Stick but I will be returning it.

reviews.t: Solid is NOT the same as the cream deodorant!
reviews.x: Between my body odor coming back strong and the multiple applications per day needed, the strength of the solid is no where near the strength of Lume’s cream deodorants. I wanted to try a solid out for convenience factor, but will just resort to finishing this off for other than underarms. The scent isn’t bad, just the power of the product isn’t equal to the cream version. Also, left several gritty white marks on clothes when the cream doesn’t leave any marks (which one may think the opposite wo

reviews.t: not as good as the creams
reviews.x: After trying the lume deodorant I was impressed. I tried the stick that had the 3 holes with the cream. So I was excited to try it in solid stick form.  The stick, it still works but it does not last as long for me. When I used the cream stick, it would last an entire 24 hours on my privates. I would still be odor free before my next shower. With this sold stick, it only lasts about 20 hours for me.  It's still a good deodorant. I just wish the solid stick lasted longer.

I really wanted an aluminum free, natural deodorant and was skeptical because others that I’ve used have irritated my skin or just plain didn’t work. I put Lume to the test while I was working outside in the heat and at the end of the day, I was surprised to find no smell! I wore it to work today for about 12 hours and still smell great. I have sensitive skin and have had no issues. If you’re on the fence, give it a try! I’m sold!

Had not even used 3/4 of the Stick of the odorant I purchased and it completely broke off the holder and then went into a million pieces when it hit my bedroom floor. It was unrepairable and I had to throw it away. I expected much better quality especially for the price of $22. Won't be buying that anytime soon. 😔😔😔

This one is not as good as controlling odor as the lume tubes or roll up products. They are more convient to apply and smell nicer though. This one would probably work better as a refresher after a long day but not very effective on it own

I have tried them all, and this is by far the best deodorant I’ve ever used! It’s worth every penny! And I think this solid version is slightly better than the tube or the stick/cream. I love the lavender scent the best.

After 40, my privates smell changed. Some days it smelled like my underarms. I was self conscious. Then I Google how to get rid of the odor and lume appeared. It worked so well and lasted in extra hot Temps. Fresh.

Love product but smell is not great, I’ve tried several different ones. Just got cucumber melon and it smells like jolly rancher’s 😞 I really don’t want to smell like candy. So far I only like jasmine rose.
This deodorant doesn’t work. It’s very expensive and doesn’t work. I tried to get a refund and they want me to return the item that I already used. Gross!!!  Don’t waste your money.
Super disappointed. I thought this would be the holy grail of deodorants, but it wears off after a few hours. Love the scent so much more though.
This deodorant should not be 20$ what makes it 20$ it really does nothing special
So far I’ve tried this one an the vanilla …they all stink so bad …

claims.text: Many reviewers find the solid stick highly effective at controlling odor, even all day or through heavy activity.
Several reviewers say the solid stick is better than the cream version, which felt wet, left residue, or had an off-putting initial scent.
Some reviewers report the solid stick does not work or does not last, requiring reapplication.
A few reviewers complain about the scent, describing it as bad or off-putting.
Some reviewers mention the price is high relative to other deodorants.
